sequential_dependency.intermediate: The collision-free joined yellow boundary and its 4-connected enclosed background regions.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Align the complete orange port patterns at unit cardinal distance, enforce reciprocal yellow coverage and no collision, then assemble the pieces.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Flood the complement of the assembled boundary and fill every enclosed blue pocket with cyan 8.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Joining can close pockets that were open in both source pieces. Filling individual pieces before docking misses those new pockets; the assembled topology is required.
